translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content: A ninge utano hinahaan uram Ierusalem.

content.text: “Di gate helar tagu ing iau ga marawaan taar tuk taar kaiken.”
Na tahut bia Israel na tange habaling hoken:
“Di gate helar tagu ing iau ga marawaan taar tuk taar kaiken.
Iesen diet pai ga petlaar bia diet na paas hasur iau.
hoing bia ira ut na tintol diet te rup no pise.
I te kut palas ise iau tano winiwis ta ira ut na sakena.”
Iau sasaring bia i tale bia da pasak pukus diet ing diet malentakuane Saion,
ma bia diet na haan laah um ma ra hirhir.
Iau sasaring bia diet na haruat ma ra huro naliu tano ula hala
ing no kasakes na se hamarangai ma pa na kubur.
Pa taie tikai i tale bia na hahungi no limana ma tari,
ma bia na ru tikane ma na pise tiga pok.
Ma taie tikai nong na haan saakit na tale bia na tange bia,
Mehet haidane ugu tano hinsana no Watong.”
